knowledge.name: Unit 1 What can you do with your five senses? / Story
Story: five senses in the park
knowledge.parent: Unit 1 What can you do with your five senses? / Story
knowledge.explanation: 读懂公园故事：用 see / hear / smell / taste / touch 描述在公园里的五种感官活动。

knowledge.name: I see with my eyes 感官句型
knowledge.parent: Unit 1 What can you do with your five senses? / Story
knowledge.explanation: 句型 I + 感官动词 + with my + 器官，如 I see with my eyes. 常错点：器官与动词不搭配（用 ears 配 see）。
prerequisites: Story: five senses in the park

knowledge.name: It smells good 第三人称感官句
knowledge.parent: Unit 1 What can you do with your five senses? / Story
knowledge.explanation: 第三人称单数做主语的感官句：It smells good. / It tastes sweet.，动词要加 s。
prerequisites: I see with my eyes 感官句型

knowledge.name: Story words: nice, loud, sweet, soft
knowledge.parent: Unit 1 What can you do with your five senses? / Story
knowledge.explanation: 故事中的评价形容词 nice / loud / sweet / soft，用来回答「感觉怎么样」。
prerequisites: It smells good 第三人称感官句

chapters.name: Unit 1 What can you do with your five senses?

questions.stem: In the story, Ben is in the park. What can he do there?
questions.analysis: 公园里能看到花，用 see，选 A；做数学、洗碗、写信都不是公园里的感官活动。
questions.knowledge_point: Story: five senses in the park

questions.stem: Which sense do you use to enjoy birdsong?
questions.analysis: 鸟叫要用耳朵听，属于 hearing，选 A；tasting 是尝味道，smelling 是闻气味，touching 是触摸。
questions.knowledge_point: Story: five senses in the park

questions.stem: We use our nose to smell flowers.
questions.analysis: 鼻子负责嗅觉，闻花香用 nose，说法正确。
questions.knowledge_point: Story: five senses in the park

questions.stem: I ____ the birds with my ears.
questions.analysis: 耳朵负责听觉，用 hear，故填 hear；填 see 要配 eyes，填 smell 要配 nose。
questions.knowledge_point: Story: five senses in the park

questions.stem: Which sentences about senses are correct?
questions.analysis: A 眼睛看 ✓；B 鼻子不能听声音，听觉器官是耳朵 ✗；C 鼻子闻气味 ✓；D 耳朵不能尝味道 ✗。故 A、C 成立，B、D 不成立。
questions.knowledge_point: Story: five senses in the park

questions.stem: At Shenzhen Bay Park, Lily ____ the sea with her ears.
questions.analysis: 听到海浪声用 hear，主语 Lily 是第三人称单数，动词加 s，选 hears；taste 是尝，smell 是闻，touch 是摸。
questions.knowledge_point: Story: five senses in the park

questions.stem: I ____ with my hands.
questions.analysis: 主语 I 后用动词原形 touch，选 A；touches 用于第三人称单数，touching 是现在分词，to touch 不能单独作谓语。
questions.knowledge_point: I see with my eyes 感官句型

questions.stem: "I taste the ice cream with my tongue." is a correct sentence about senses.
questions.analysis: 舌头负责味觉，taste 与 tongue 搭配正确，说法正确。
questions.knowledge_point: I see with my eyes 感官句型

questions.stem: I see the rainbow with my ____.
questions.analysis: 看东西用眼睛，复数 eyes 更自然，故填 eyes；填 eye 单数在「两只眼睛」的语境下不规范。
questions.knowledge_point: I see with my eyes 感官句型

questions.stem: Which sentences match the right sense organ?
options: I smell the soup with my nose.
I see the song with my ears.
I hear the music with my ears.
I hear the picture with my eyes.
questions.analysis: A 鼻子闻汤 ✓；B 歌要用耳朵听，不能用 see ✗；C 耳朵听音乐 ✓；D 图画要用眼睛看，不能用 hear ✗。故 A、C 成立，B、D 不成立。
questions.knowledge_point: I see with my eyes 感官句型

questions.stem: The soup ____ good.
questions.analysis: 主语 The soup 是第三人称单数，动词加 s，选 smells；smell 用于 I / we / they。
questions.knowledge_point: It smells good 第三人称感官句

questions.stem: "It sounds loud." uses an adjective after the sense verb.
questions.analysis: sounds 后面接形容词 loud 说明声音的特点，说法正确。
questions.knowledge_point: It smells good 第三人称感官句

questions.stem: The cake ____ sweet.
questions.analysis: 主语 The cake 是第三人称单数，感官动词加 s，故填 tastes；写 taste 与单数主语不一致。
questions.knowledge_point: It smells good 第三人称感官句

questions.stem: Which sentences are correct with sense verbs?
questions.analysis: A It 后用 smells，句子正确 ✓；B It 后少了 s ✗；C It 后用 tastes，句子正确 ✓；D tasting 不能单独作谓语 ✗。故 A、C 成立，B、D 不成立。
questions.knowledge_point: It smells good 第三人称感官句

questions.stem: "How does the lemon taste?" "It ____ sour."
questions.analysis: 答句主语 It 是第三人称单数，用 tastes，选 A；其余三项都不能与 It 直接作谓语。
questions.knowledge_point: It smells good 第三人称感官句

questions.stem: Which word describes a very loud sound?
questions.analysis: loud 指声音大，选 A；sweet 是甜，soft 是柔软或轻柔，sour 是酸。
questions.knowledge_point: Story words: nice, loud, sweet, soft

questions.stem: The word "sweet" can describe the taste of candy.
questions.analysis: sweet 表示甜，可以形容糖果的味道，说法正确。
questions.knowledge_point: Story words: nice, loud, sweet, soft

questions.stem: The pillow is ____. I can sleep well.
questions.analysis: 能让人睡得好，说明枕头很软，故填 soft；填 loud 指声音大，与枕头不符。
questions.knowledge_point: Story words: nice, loud, sweet, soft

questions.stem: Write two sentences about what you can do with your senses in the park.

answer.value: I see the green trees. I hear the birds singing.

questions.analysis: 评分要点：①写出一个视觉句子，如 I see ...（1 分）；②写出一个听觉句子，如 I hear ...（1 分）；③两句英文完整、主谓一致（1 分）；④拼写与标点正确（1 分）。两句都用同一个感官扣 1 分。
questions.knowledge_point: Story words: nice, loud, sweet, soft

questions.stem: Your mum cooks soup at home. Write two sentences: what you smell and how it tastes.

answer.value: I smell the soup with my nose. It tastes nice.

questions.analysis: 评分要点：①用 smell 写闻到的动作并搭配 nose（1 分）；②用 It tastes + 形容词 写味道（1 分）；③两句完整、第三人称单数动词加 s（1 分）；④拼写与标点正确（1 分）。
questions.knowledge_point: Story words: nice, loud, sweet, soft
